_doc: Two-Mac edit routing (handoff 03, Dan, 2026-11-12; built 2026-11-14). The ONE place for the per-Mac numbers. Change a number here and every tool follows: editcap.py (edit slots), renderq.py (cores), editroute.py (where the next edit goes). README.md beside this file explains each field.

m6.label: M6 (Dan's Mac)
m6.drives_note: No external drives. The Extreme and Seagate stay plugged into the M2 (exFAT, cannot be shared over SMB). An M6 edit works on this Mac's internal SSD and copies the footage it needs from the M2 with editroute.py fetch.

m2.label: M2 Pro (edit machine)
m2.drives_note: Holds the Extreme and the Seagate (Expansion). M2 edits read footage in place. Work folders go on the Extreme first: the M2's internal drive has about 54 GB free (2026-11-14). Finished jobs move to the Seagate here, checksummed.
